name: LSH
recent: LSH Capital 于2026年10月8日从创业板转至主板上市。2026年11月25日公布截至9月30日的季度业绩，净利同比下滑。公司同时宣布派发每股1.08仙的中期单层股息。
notable: 2026年10月8日，公司从创业板转至主板上市。
2026年11月25日，公司公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩。
2026年11月25日，公司宣布派发每股1.08仙的中期单层股息。
risks: 2026年11月13日至23日期间，执行副主席Datuk Lim Keng Guan及执行董事Lim Ding Shyong在闭市期多次申报增持公司股份。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为1.127亿令吉，环比增长13.4%，但同比下降7.5%；净利为1497万令吉，环比下降19.5%，同比下降42.7%；净利率为13.3%，低于上一季度的18.7%。

recent_en: LSH Capital transferred its listing from the ACE Market to the Main Market on 8 October 2026. On 25 November 2026, it announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September, with net profit declining year-on-year. The company also declared an interim single-tier dividend of 1.08 sen per share.
notable_en: On 8 October 2026, the company transferred its listing from the ACE Market to the Main Market.
On 25 November 2026, the company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
On 25 November 2026, the company declared an interim single-tier dividend of 1.08 sen per share.
risks_en: Between 13 and 23 November 2026, Executive Vice Chairman Datuk Lim Keng Guan and Executive Director Lim Ding Shyong made multiple notifications of share acquisitions during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM112.7 million, up 13.4% quarter-on-quarter but down 7.5% year-on-year; net profit was RM14.97 million, down 19.5% quarter-on-quarter and 42.7% year-on-year; net margin was 13.3%, lower than 18.7% in the previous quarter.
